•	Lead reporting, analysis and insights to drive both paid and organic social strategies
•	Social performance forecasting, budgeting process and allocation with client and internal stakeholders
•	Monthly budget reconciliation and invoicing 

Salary - $85-$95k package


Senior Social Media Manager (Also known as Social Director, Social Lead)

Responsibilities might include:
•	Developing, executing, optimising and monitoring effective social campaigns and always on strategies to reach campaign KPIS and drive business growth across the portfolio across all key social platforms – Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest, LinkedIn, TikTok, Snapchat

•	Leading the development of creative assets, including ideation, copy and posting cadence 
•	Acting as the brand guardian, developing and ensuring consistent portrayal of brands across all social channels 
•	Lead reporting, analysis and insights to drive both paid and organic social strategies
•	Social performance forecasting, budgeting process and allocation with client and internal stakeholders
•	Monthly budget reconciliation and invoicing

Position: Civil Engineering Draftsperson
Position Type: Full Time
Salary: $80,000 - $90,000 p/a plus Super
Employer Name: OZI HOMES PTY LTD - T/a OZI HOMES
A.B.N. 21 649 504 441
Job Location: 2 Kenelda Av,, Guildford, NSW, 2161,  AUSTRALIA
Advertising Period: 28 days - 3 Jul 2026 > 31 Jul 2026

Please include Reference: J1690-Workforce in the Subject Line and email all applications and CV to apply@jobsource.net.au

Summary

Our client is seeking to add a Civil Engineering Draftsperson to its residential building and construction business based in Guildford, New South Wales. Ozi Homes Pty Ltd supports the planning and delivery of residential construction projects and requires a capable draftsperson to prepare accurate civil engineering drawings, technical plans and supporting documentation across construction, site development and project coordination activities.

The typical job responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:

- Preparing detailed civil engineering drawings and technical plans for construction and infrastructure projects.
- Producing site layouts, drainage plans and structural drafting documentation using CAD software.
- Assisting engineers with drafting support across residential and commercial building developments.
- Reviewing engineering sketches and converting concepts into accurate technical construction drawings.
- Preparing plans for stormwater, sewerage and civil infrastructure construction works.
- Interpreting engineering instructions and applying drafting procedures to project documentation requirements.
- Coordinating drawing revisions based on engineering feedback and construction site requirements.
- Maintaining accurate drawing registers, technical records and drafting version control procedures.
- Liaising with engineers, project managers and contractors regarding drafting updates and specifications.
- Ensuring engineering drawings comply with Australian standards, regulations and contract requirements.
- Preparing sketches, charts and tabulated information supporting engineering and construction activities.
- Conducting quantity calculations and assisting with material estimation for civil construction projects.
- Supporting construction teams with technical drafting information during project delivery stages.
- Inspecting completed drafting work to ensure accuracy, consistency and compliance requirements.
- Assisting with project coordination and resolving drafting discrepancies during construction activities.

Applicants must meet the following minimum requirements to be considered for the role:

- Diploma or Advanced Diploma qualification in Civil Engineering Drafting, Engineering Design or closely related technical discipline.
- Minimum 12 months experience preparing civil engineering drawings using industry-standard CAD drafting software within construction environments.
- Comprehensive understanding of Australian construction standards, engineering documentation requirements and relevant regulatory compliance obligations.
- Ability to interpret technical engineering information and prepare accurate construction and infrastructure drafting documentation independently.
- Experience supporting residential and commercial construction projects with high levels of drafting accuracy and technical detail.
- Well-developed communication skills when liaising with engineers, contractors, project managers and external construction stakeholders professionally.
- Strong organisational abilities managing multiple drafting priorities while maintaining documentation accuracy and project delivery deadlines consistently.
- Practical knowledge of drainage, sewerage, infrastructure and site development drafting within Australian construction project environments.

Please include Reference: J1690-Workforce in the Subject Line and email all applications and CV to apply@jobsource.net.au

Due to the volume of applicants, only those meeting the minimum standards will be considered and only successful applicants will be contacted.  Thank you for your interest in the role.

result.description: Northrop Consulting Engineers  About the Role  In this role, you will contribute to the design and delivery of safe, efficient, and compliant structural engineering solutions for a range of building projects, with a particular focus on  post-tensioned concrete design . Working alongside experienced engineers, you will be involved in structural analysis, modelling, documentation, and multidisciplinary coordination from concept through to construction while ensuring compliance with Australian Standards and project requirements.               Benefits   Competitive salary package.  Work on diverse and technically challenging building projects.  Ongoing professional development and mentoring from experienced engineers.  Exposure to advanced structural engineering software and post-tensioned concrete design.  Collaborative and supportive team environment.  Career progression opportunities within a growing engineering consultancy.  Opportunity to work on projects that positively impact communities and the built environment.    Task & responsibilities  The Structural Engineer is responsible for delivering safe, efficient, and compliant structural engineering designs across building projects, with a specialist focus on detailed post-tensioned concrete design. The role contributes to analysis, modelling, and documentation from concept through to construction, ensuring coordination with architectural and services disciplines. Working under senior guidance, the engineer supports project delivery by producing accurate, buildable solutions that meet client, code, and program requirements.      Perform structural analysis, modelling, and design for building structures, including post-tensioned concrete slabs.  Prepare accurate engineering calculations, drawings, specifications, and design documentation.  Develop practical, efficient, and buildable structural solutions.  Coordinate structural designs with architects, civil engineers, services engineers, and drafters.  Ensure designs comply with Australian Standards (AS/NZS), the National Construction Code (NCC), and relevant authority requirements. Global Vision Recruitment on behalf of DMC Electrical and Air Cooling Pty Ltd

Date Posted: 10 July 2026

Position: Mechanical Engineer

Salary: $80,000 - $100,000 per annum plus 12% superannuation

Mode: Full-time

Hours: 38 hours per week

Location: 11 Parkside Drive, Condon QLD 4815

Experience required: Minimum 1 year experience as a Mechanical Engineer or in a similar role

DMC Electrical and Air Cooling Pty Ltd is a well-established provider of commercial and residential electrical, air conditioning, HVAC, and sheet metal solutions, proudly servicing Condon and surrounding regions for nearly 40 years. The company specialises in the design, fabrication, installation, maintenance, and repair of mechanical air conditioning and ventilation systems, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to each client's needs. 

Due to continued growth, we are seeking a qualified and motivated Mechanical Engineer to join our team. This role is ideal for an engineer with strong experience in HVAC system design, ductwork engineering, heat load calculations, AutoCAD drafting, and project management.

Key Responsibilities include but not limited to:

•	Design HVAC and ventilation systems for commercial and residential projects, ensuring efficient, practical, and compliant mechanical solutions. 

•	Perform heat load calculations and airflow analysis to determine equipment capacities and optimise system performance. 

•	Prepare detailed 2D AutoCAD drawings and 3D mechanical models for ductwork layouts, plant rooms, and equipment installations. 

•	Design ducting systems, select suitable mechanical equipment, and prepare technical specifications for fabrication and installation. 

•	Manage multiple mechanical projects from design through to installation and commissioning, ensuring completion within agreed budgets and timeframes. 

•	Prepare engineering documentation including mechanical drawings, material schedules, equipment selections, fabrication details, and project reports. 

•	Estimate material quantities, project costs, labour requirements, and procurement schedules to support successful project delivery. 

•	Conduct site inspections, testing, commissioning, and performance assessments to verify system functionality and identify engineering improvements where required. 

•	Analyse technical data, resolve engineering issues, and recommend practical solutions to improve system efficiency, constructability, and operational performance. 

•	Liaise closely with electrical, refrigeration, sheet metal, and construction teams to ensure seamless coordination across multidisciplinary projects. 

•	Ensure all engineering designs, installations, and completed works comply with relevant Australian Standards, the National Construction Code (NCC), workplace health and safety legislation, and contractual requirements. 

Qualifications:

•	Tertiary qualification in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline. 

•	Minimum 1 year experience as a Mechanical Engineer or in a similar role. 

Other Skills and Requirements: 

•	Demonstrated experience in HVAC system design, duct design, and heat load calculations. 

•	Proficiency in AutoCAD 2D and experience developing 3D mechanical drawings/models. 

•	Strong project coordination and project management skills within mechanical services or HVAC projects. 

•	Knowledge of Australian Standards, NCC requirements, and mechanical engineering principles relating to air conditioning and ventilation systems. 

•	Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and organisational skills. 

•	Ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining high standards of quality, safety, and attention to detail. 

If you are an experienced Mechanical Engineer seeking a long-term opportunity with a respected and growing mechanical services company, we encourage you to apply and become part of the team at DMC Electrical and Air Cooling Pty Ltd. 

Email your resume to recruit@gvrc.com.au. Please note that only shortlisted candidate will be contacted.

## Network Analyst
## Position Overview
We are looking for an experienced and analytical Network Analyst to join our team and play a key role in maintaining, optimising, and evolving our organisation's network infrastructure. The successful candidate will be responsible for researching and analysing network architecture, recommending strategies for network design and planning, and ensuring systems operate at peak performance. This role suits a detail-oriented professional with a strong technical background who is equally comfortable working on strategic planning as they are on day-to-day network operations. You will collaborate closely with IT teams and stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable network solutions across the organisation.
## Key Responsibilities
- Analyse, develop, and evaluate complex network architecture, system design specifications, data models, and diagrams to support the configuration, integration, and ongoing development of computer systems
- Research, monitor, and assess network infrastructure to ensure all systems are correctly configured and consistently operating at optimal performance levels
- Monitor network traffic, activity, capacity, and usage on an ongoing basis to maintain network integrity, identify anomalies, and proactively address performance issues before they escalate
- Identify opportunities for improvement across network operations and recommend enhancements to integrated hardware, software, communications, and operating systems
- Design, plan, and coordinate network architecture strategies that align with the organisation's broader technology goals and operational requirements
- Perform routine and scheduled network maintenance, including software and hardware upgrades, patch management, and system backups to ensure continuity and resilience
- Troubleshoot and resolve network faults, connectivity issues, and performance degradation, providing timely support to internal teams and end users
- Develop and maintain comprehensive network documentation, including topology diagrams, configuration records, and operational procedures
- Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends, providing informed recommendations on tools and solutions that could improve network capability and efficiency
- Collaborate with cross-functional IT teams, vendors, and stakeholders to support infrastructure projects, system integrations, and technology upgrades
- Contribute to the development and enforcement of network policies, standards, and security protocols to safeguard the organisation's data and systems
- Assist in capacity planning and forecasting to ensure the network infrastructure can support current and future organisational demands
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related discipline
- Demonstrated experience in a network analysis, network engineering, or similar IT infrastructure role
- Strong working knowledge of networking protocols, technologies, and concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, BGP, and OSPF
- Proven experience monitoring and managing enterprise network environments using industry-standard tools and platforms
- Solid understanding of network security principles, firewalls, access controls, and best practices
- Experience with network hardware from leading vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, or Palo Alto
- Ability to analyse complex technical data, interpret performance metrics, and translate findings into actionable recommendations
- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve network issues efficiently under pressure
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work autonomously, and contribute effectively within a team environment
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent vendor-specific credentials
- Experience working within large-scale or enterprise-level network environments
- Familiarity with cloud networking platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud
- Knowledge of network automation tools and scripting languages such as Python or Ansible
- Experience with SD-WAN technologies and software-defined networking concepts
- Exposure to ITIL frameworks or experience working within a managed service provider (MSP) environment
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking technology team that values innovation and continuous improvement
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications and training programmes
- Enjoy a flexible working environment with hybrid arrangements available to support work-life balance
- Competitive remuneration package with clearly defined career progression pathways
- Work on diverse and meaningful infrastructure projects that directly impact the performance and reliability of the wider organisation
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

result.description: SDO  The Production Engineer is responsible for planning, developing and optimising manufacturing processes for the production of optical fibre current sensors, optical current transformers, transducers and related electrical monitoring equipment. The role focuses on improving manufacturing efficiency, product quality and production performance through engineering analysis, process optimisation and continuous improvement while ensuring compliance with engineering specifications, quality standards and workplace safety requirements.   Benefits   Task & responsibilities   Duties:    Plan and improve manufacturing processes for the production of optical fibre current sensors, current transformers, transducers and related electrical products.  Analyse production processes and identify opportunities to improve productivity, product quality and manufacturing efficiency.  Prepare and maintain manufacturing documentation, including work instructions, standard operating procedures (SOPs) and process specifications.  Coordinate production activities to ensure products are manufactured on time and meet quality standards.  Investigate production issues, equipment faults and product defects, and implement corrective actions.  Monitor production performance and recommend process improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce waste.  Support the introduction of new products through production trials, process validation and manufacturing implementation.  Evaluate manufacturing equipment and recommend upgrades or process improvements to improve production performance.  Ensure manufacturing activities comply with engineering specifications, quality standards, workplace health and safety requirements and relevant Australian standards.  Work closely with Engineering, Quality, Production and Supply Chain teams to support continuous improvement and achieve production objectives.    Responsibilities:    Ensure manufacturing processes operate efficiently and achieve production and quality targets.  Maintain accurate engineering and production documentation.  Provide technical support to production staff and assist in resolving manufacturing issues.  Monitor product quality and ensure compliance with engineering specifications and company standards.  Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and implement practical engineering solutions.  Support equipment commissioning, process validation and engineering change implementation.  Ensure compliance with Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) policies and company procedures.  Collaborate with internal teams to support production planning and timely customer delivery.     Qualification & experience   Bachelor's degree or higher in Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.  Minimum of one (1) year of relevant full-time work experience as a Production Engineer or in a similar manufacturing engineering role.  Knowledge of manufacturing processes, production planning and process improvement.  Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.  Understanding of quality management systems and workplace health and safety (WHS) requirements.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.  Good communication and teamwork skills.  Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with ERP/MRP systems or manufacturing software is an advantage.   About Company    Founded in Sydney in 2004, Smart Digital Optics (SDO) manufactures optical fibre current sensors for the electric power and smelting industries. Smart Digital Optics is one of the first companies to incorporate optical fibre current sensors into power monitoring and metering systems allowing users to measure electric currents with unprecedented levels of accuracy and ease. The digitally compatible and compact SDO products offer superior utility and performance compared to costly and cumbersome traditional approaches.  In 2010 SDO formed a strategic alliance with the Arteche Group. Arteche has 65 years of experience in the manufacture of electrical power products for generation, transmission, distribution and industrial applications. As an international benchmark with equipment in service in over 150 countries, it has companies in Europe, America, Asia and Oceania, as well as a service network comprised of more than 80 technical and sales offices.  The combination of SDO’s technology expertise with Arteche’s long experience in the electricity sector provides customers with a partner well equipped to support the introduce new technology for advanced transmission and industrial systems.   Technology :   SDO uses its expertise in advanced optics and signal processing to develop solutions for power engineering applications.  SDO’s optical current sensors utilize the Faraday effect in optical fibre, whereby the state of polarization of the light propagating in the fibre interacts with the magnetic field around a conductor.This effect is highly linear and provides the basis of an ultra high bandwidth, wide dynamic range current sensor which measures both AC and DC current with high accuracy.
